purpose: Observe the final unchanged-production reference-role controls, preserve actual nested missing-race evidence, then prove the reviewed source and full required gates.

tests.scope: Four final test/data paths only; model, scanner and nested runtime helper remain unchanged until candidate application.

contracts.qualified_operator: The exact unaliased qualified-operator SQL is a positive native/direct-Generate reference control. Source-pinned SQLc is predicted to emit one empty-named A_Expr output column; both unchanged and repaired real pipelines must reproduce the existing exact column-0-needs-an-alias refusal before the version check. No SQL spelling or direct expectation is altered.
contracts.unchanged_pipeline: All eight appended exact queries run through unchanged real SQLc first. Six must generate; the unaliased symbolic operator must reach the existing exact output-column refusal, and the unquoted unqualified operator(name) source must reproduce its syntax rejection before invoking the plugin. Unexpected actual results fail before production application.
contracts.request_identity: The27 candidate captured query metadata/text objects must equal authenticated original20 or same-job unchanged7 records, including output columns. The one upstream syntax control must have no request/generated files on either source.
contracts.nested_race: Actual two distinct generated modules must execute ['test','-race','-count=1','-v','.'] through the immutable real compiler. Authenticated baseline requires exactly the corresponding missing-race vectors.
contracts.operator_function: Qualified public.operator(name) with a bare version alias is native-valid and must be refused. The exact unqualified operator(name) spelling is preserved as a PostgreSQL and SQLc syntax-error control. The sole added proof-schema function and all28 SQL/direct-allow values stay unchanged.
contracts.direct_refusal_scope: Seventeen unchanged-source direct-Generate failures comprise16 native-valid reference-role refusals plus one preserved syntax-control refusal; eleven genuine reference controls pass. This does not claim the upstream-rejected spelling is valid PostgreSQL.

source_review.operator_correction: The OPERATOR construct must start at an unqualified keyword and contain an optional qualified-name prefix followed only by symbolic operator characters from PostgreSQL REL_18_4 scan.l. The qualified function named operator remains an ordinary operand; the unqualified operator(name) spelling is an explicit native/upstream syntax-rejection control.

findings.problem: Quoted identifier text was used as structural punctuation.
findings.correction: All delimiter, depth, cast and name-head checks now require referencePunctuation through the private punctuation method.

findings.problem: The closing parenthesis of a qualified OPERATOR name was treated as the end of an expression that could take a bare alias.
findings.correction: Bare-alias classification now distinguishes OPERATOR's matching parentheses by token kind and depth.

findings.problem: The final name component operator before '(' was treated as the OPERATOR construct even for a normal function.
findings.correction: Require unqualified construct spelling plus an actual symbolic operator name inside the matching parentheses.

observer_path.reason: Actual test launcher prepended GOROOT/bin; initial PATH-only observer omitted nested records.

credential_boundary: SPIRA_ARTIFACT_TOKEN exists only in the verifier step; no compiler command runs in that shell before Python pops it as its first main statement. The actual go-cache-disabled command remains after removal. The token is passed explicitly only to immutable artifact authentication.
